fix.summary: Direct Fixer Apply at fixed HEAD 8eaaa0c27696bd78d0d83cb5b2eddc514211b76c. Repair the implementation defects and retained minimal proof gaps below; do not add a Plan, restore deleted suite mass, build role/corruption cross-products, or expand into #12/#13/#22/#26.

classes.name: ISS33-COMPACT-SESSION-STATE
classes.boundary: Streaming an initially bound Pi-v3 JSONL snapshot through framing, chain validation, and acceptance-candidate extraction without retaining every parsed row
classes.disposition: Sustained implementation defect. `readSession` appends every parsed object to `rows: unknown[]`, returns that array, and `runRecorder` only then calls `extractAcceptedReceipt`; at the lawful 100000-entry and 16-MiB-per-line limits this is not compact memory. Refactor the owner seam so framing/hash/identity checks and lifecycle extraction retain only bounded carry, chain/id state, and the compact package-lifecycle candidate state needed for the final Receipt. Keep the existing exact entry/line limits and snapshot verification. Add an observable regression that fails if the design again accumulates all parsed rows; do not add a test-only production hook.

classes.name: ISS33-PUBLIC-V2-SYNCHRONIZATION
classes.boundary: Shipped v2 schemas accepting exactly representative runtime-emitted success/failure objects and rejecting impossible or stale public objects
classes.disposition: Sustained implementation and proof defect; Reviewer Standards' closure claim is disproved by current files. Manifest v2 still has `receipt.oneOf` with `type: null` and a null-receipt conditional branch although runtime `RecorderManifestV2` and `validatePublicManifest` require a Receipt. Failure v2 still admits diagnostic stage `cleanup`, omits runtime stage `session`, and omits runtime location segments `session` and `directory`. Synchronize schemas with runtime and add representative runtime-object/schema tracers plus explicit null/stale counterexamples. This is the independently valid prior public-schema finding.

classes.name: ISS33-COUNTER-CHILD-INVOCATION
classes.boundary: Pre-spawn rejection and one valid real child invocation with the bound session argv, environment, stdin, and separated pass-through streams
classes.disposition: Sustained proof gap, narrowed exactly by C8. Current tests call `parseRecorderArgv` only and no test calls `runRecorder`. Add one representative invalid counter-child case proving zero spawn and one valid production-seam case proving exactly one spawn, absolute `--session-dir` and configured `--session-id` immediately after the executable, preservation of remaining argv, inherited `PI_SESSION_DIR` removal, configured environment precedence, stdin inheritance, and nonmerged stdout/stderr. Do not repeat all parser rejections through the child.

classes.name: ISS33-LIFECYCLE-CUSTOM-ORACLES
classes.owner: Native lifecycle extractor and its leaf tests (`src/recorder/extract.ts`, `test/native-session-sealer.test.ts`)
classes.boundary: Missing-versus-invalid and unique-final-acceptance decisions from direct package lifecycle occurrences, excluding Pi-native persisted-row format
classes.disposition: Sustained proof gap. Existing tests cover rejection-then-success, rejection-only, one mismatched rejection, and duplicate successes, but omit retained custom branches such as nested lookalikes/no lifecycle, wrong accepted text or details, and post-success content. Add only representative custom branch oracles sufficient for the amended minimal lifecycle table; do not recreate exhaustive syntactic permutations.

classes.name: ISS33-ADR0016-FORMAT-ONLY-TESTS
classes.owner: Recorder lifecycle test suite (`test/native-session-sealer.test.ts`) under ADR 0016
classes.boundary: Tests of custom lifecycle logic versus Pi-native persisted-row closed formatting
classes.disposition: Sustained standards defect, not an implementation failure. Delete the two format-only extra-field tests named `rejected lifecycle rows still require the direct closed Pi shape` and `accepted issuance and result reject extra persisted fields`. Preserve or replace only custom cross-field/branch evidence; Pi-native shape formatting is outside this suite's test ownership.

classes.name: ISS33-LIFECYCLE-SHAPE-DEDUPLICATION
classes.boundary: Common direct issuance/result pair validation shared by rejected and accepted branches, with accepted-only text/details/validator rules layered once
classes.disposition: Sustained style/maintainability concern. The loop validates the closed outer/message pair and the accepted-final path repeats near-identical `exact(...)` checks. Consolidate the common lifecycle-pair invariants into one domain-named path, then apply accepted-only semantics once. Do not introduce a second validator framework or duplicate package-owned accepted-details validators.

classes.name: ISS33-RECORDER-EXTRACTION-VERTICALS
classes.boundary: Representative native role sealing and truthful scanning/revalidation of promoted derivatives while raw session/stream bytes remain unpromoted and unclaimed
classes.disposition: Sustained retained C8 proof gap. There is no `runRecorder` test and current extractor tests exercise only Coder. Keep cheap package/dispatch leaf coverage for the five terminating tools, including Collector projection and audited-role observation/usage, then use only a representative Recorder vertical set (ordinary worker, one audited role, and Collector, or equivalently strong coverage). Prove one credential-bearing accepted derivative is sanitized, revalidated, labelled and reported; clean derivative acceptance; scan-induced invalid derivative abort; and raw-session/stdout secrets are neither promoted nor represented as scanned. Do not run every role through every corruption case.

classes.name: ISS33-TRANSACTION-PUBLICATION-VERTICALS
classes.boundary: Settled child truth, sealer-failure precedence, pre-publication snapshot verification, atomic no-replace complete-tree publication, and raw-source exclusion
classes.disposition: Sustained proof gap. Add minimal production-seam verticals for: nonzero exit plus valid session publishes and returns that code; signal plus valid session publishes and preserves/re-raises that signal; settled child plus independent sealer failure publishes nothing, returns 125, and records the known child outcome and honest cause; competing publication attempts yield one intact winner without overwrite; and a successful docket excludes main/leg sessions and raw streams while containing promoted derivatives. One successful path must cross the existing immediate pre-promotion `session.verify()`. No role/failure cross-product is authorized.

classes.name: ISS33-PACKAGED-RECORDER-SEAM
classes.owner: Recorder package boundary (`package.json`, `bin/ak-docket-record.js`, generated `dist/recorder/**`, shipped `schemas/recorder-*-v2.schema.json`, package lifecycle tests)
classes.boundary: Cold-installed Recorder CLI using the same native-session v2 implementation and public assets shipped by the tarball
classes.disposition: Sustained proof gap. Package inventory currently lists the Recorder binary, dist modules, native helper, and v2 schemas, but no test invokes the cold-installed Recorder binary. Add a minimal installed-bin Recorder smoke covering the packaged production seam, with success/failure represented only as needed; do not run all roles end to end. Retain source/package inventory evidence that the superseded v1 transport core is absent.

classes.name: ISS33-SECURITY-SOURCE-READABILITY
classes.boundary: Human reviewability of identity, mutation, child-outcome, manifest, and stream-forwarding decisions
classes.disposition: Sustained style-only concern. Dense one-line control flow and names such as `s`, `ds`, `x`, `m`, `im`, `o`, and `c` obscure trust decisions. Reformat touched security logic into readable statement boundaries and use domain-revealing names (including fixture helpers where touched) without changing contracts or adding mechanisms.

details.note: HEAD and clean worktree were verified. A current-head `npm test` run passes 299 tests (294 pass, 5 skips), but no test references `runRecorder`, and schema/runtime contradictions remain mechanically visible. The prior active-read-during-synchronous-stream timing requirement is withdrawn and is not part of this repair; existing post-snapshot replacement/growth/shrink/metadata/inventory tests are retained evidence. Current real-filesystem session identity/inventory tests, representative Pi-v3 framing/limit tests, and the >2-GiB bounded forwarding leaf are otherwise accepted; no old line count, suite count, exhaustive role matrix, or corruption cross-product is required. This adjudication does not authorize merge/closure decisions or work on #12/#13/#22/#26.
